=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py:75-80 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_base_env()` copies `os.environ` but does not strip `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED`, so baseline subprocesses can inherit the runner’s flag state.
  WHY: When the env var is set in CI, baseline and comparison runs diverge and the identity-recall byte-stability / stderr assertions become flaky.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:554-568, 621 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `inject_identity_recall_block` is annotated `str | None`, but every code path returns a string and the `if updated_prompt_text is None` guard is unreachable.
  WHY: The annotation and caller contract are misleading dead code today, so the `injection_failed` path cannot fire.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:617-644 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: On canonical-prompt load failures, `apply_identity_recall_block` returns the original text unchanged while emitting `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL` to stderr, so the injected block silently disappears.
  WHY: The fail-open behavior preserves the prompt text but drops the recall block, and stderr-only signaling can be missed by downstream consumers.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:179-184, 243-248 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The shell identity-recall implementation was removed, so callers that still invoke `render_prompt.sh` with `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` no longer get the injected block.
  WHY: This breaks backward compatibility and shell/Python parity for older bundled consumers.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:417-421 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_identity_reinject_enabled()` reads `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED` from the environment, introducing an implicit execution path.
  WHY: It is opt-in only via environment variable, so there is no current runtime failure, but it broadens the execution surface.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "Phase B — inject identity recall blocks after prompt rendering ... the canonical renderer becomes the single source of truth, producing one correctly placed recall block with shell/Python parity and byte-stable flag-off output."
  expected_change_site: prompts/_identity_recall.txt (the identity recall block template rendered by render_identity_recall_block)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk references prompts/_identity_recall.txt. The rendering helper discover_identity_recall_template_path and the block injection logic exist, but the template file required by the contract is absent.
- requirement: "the canonical renderer becomes the single source of truth, producing one correctly placed recall block"
  expected_change_site: shell parity contract between workflows using render_prompt.sh and those calling render_prompt.py directly
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/render_prompt.sh no longer contains an identity-recall helper branch. Any workspace still invoking render_prompt.sh with UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true will not get the identity block.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
